Jabalpur Outer Ring Road Package-02 | Detailed Ground Update
In this video, we explore the latest ground progress of Package-02 of the 114 KM Jabalpur Outer Ring Road Project, one of the biggest infrastructure projects in the Mahakaushal Region of Madhya Pradesh.
Package-02 starts near Manegaon and extends up to NH-45 (Khairi), covering nearly 20 kilometers. We take a detailed drive through the entire package, covering construction progress, earthwork, fly ash embankment, major bridges, minor bridges, vehicular underpasses, RE walls, proposed toll plaza, & service roads.
